+"""Command-line entry points; load simulation dependencies only when needed."""
+import argparse
+from importlib import import_module
+import os
+
+COMMANDS = {
+    'setup-assets': ('dexgpt.assets', 'Download upstream robot assets and the hand landmark model'),
+    'extract-motion': ('dexgpt.motion.extract', 'Extract hand landmarks and the observed hinge trajectory'),
+    'retarget': ('dexgpt.motion.retarget', 'Fit robot hand kinematics to the recorded landmarks'),
+    'build-scene': ('dexgpt.simulation.scene', 'Build the baseline MuJoCo scene'),
+    'simulate': ('dexgpt.simulation.rollout', 'Run contact physics and render the comparison video'),
+    'view-simulation': ('dexgpt.simulation.viewer', 'Open the interactive recorded-physics viewer'),
+    'run-pipeline': ('dexgpt.pipeline', 'Build the baseline scene, retarget, and simulate'),
+    'project-grasp': ('dexgpt.refinement.project', 'Project the archived grasp clear of the object and simulate'),
+    'refine-contact': ('dexgpt.refinement.contact', 'Fit a task-space contact grasp and simulate'),
+    'refine-physics': ('dexgpt.refinement.physics', 'Tighten wrist and contact compliance and simulate'),
+    'refine-feedback': ('dexgpt.refinement.feedback', 'Replay with simulated hinge-state feedback'),
+    'refine-thumb': ('dexgpt.refinement.thumb', 'Retract the thumb with collision-constrained IK'),
+    'tune-contact-compliance': ('dexgpt.refinement.compliance', 'Reduce contact compliance and simulate'),
+    'audit': ('dexgpt.reporting.audit', 'Audit recorded states and write the audit report'),
+    'diagnose': ('dexgpt.reporting.diagnose', 'Print recorded grasp and state diagnostics'),
+    'inspect-artifacts': ('dexgpt.reporting.artifacts', 'Print an image as a compact base64 JPEG'),
+    'finalize': ('dexgpt.reporting.finalize', 'Audit results and regenerate the README and review page'),
+}
+
+
+def main(argv=None):
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="python -m dexgpt", description="Reconstruct human motion and evaluate Sharpa Wave manipulation.")
+    subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
+    for name, (_, description) in COMMANDS.items():
+        command = subparsers.add_parser(name, help=description, description=description)
+        if name == "run-pipeline":
+            command.add_argument("--inspect", action="store_true", help="Build and render the baseline scene only")
+            command.add_argument("--reuse-retarget", action="store_true", help="Reuse existing retargeted controls")
+        elif name == "simulate":
+            command.add_argument("--feedback", action="store_true", help="Use simulated hinge-state feedback")
+        elif name == "inspect-artifacts":
+            command.add_argument("image", nargs="?", help="Image path (default: outputs/frame_068.jpg)")
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+    # The interactive viewer needs the native display backend. Set EGL before
+    # importing MuJoCo for commands that can render offscreen.
+    if args.command in {
+        "run-pipeline", "simulate", "project-grasp", "refine-contact",
+        "refine-physics", "refine-feedback", "refine-thumb", "tune-contact-compliance",
+    }:
+        os.environ.setdefault("MUJOCO_GL", "egl")
+    module = import_module(COMMANDS[args.command][0])
+    if args.command == "run-pipeline":
+        forwarded = []
+        if args.inspect:
+            forwarded.append("--inspect")
+        if args.reuse_retarget:
+            forwarded.append("--reuse-retarget")
+        module.main(forwarded)
+    elif args.command == "simulate":
+        module.main(feedback=args.feedback)
+    elif args.command == "inspect-artifacts":
+        module.main([args.image] if args.image is not None else [])
+    else:
+        module.main()

+import argparse
+import base64
+from io import BytesIO
+from PIL import Image
+
+from dexgpt.paths import OUT

+
+def main(argv=None):
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument('image', nargs='?', default=str(OUT / 'frame_068.jpg'))
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+    with Image.open(args.image) as image:
+        image.thumbnail((1440, 800))
+        buffer = BytesIO()
+        image.save(buffer, format='JPEG', quality=85)
+    print(base64.b64encode(buffer.getvalue()).decode())
+

+"""Regression checks for package imports, commands, and recorded-data workflows."""
+import contextlib
+import importlib
+import io
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import unittest
+from unittest.mock import Mock, patch
+
+from dexgpt import cli
+from dexgpt.paths import OUT, ROOT
+
+
+class CommandTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_help_without_simulation_dependencies(self):
+        # -S disables site-packages: help must work before dependencies are installed.
+        for arguments in [[], *[[command] for command in cli.COMMANDS]]:
+            with self.subTest(arguments=arguments):
+                result = subprocess.run(
+                    [sys.executable, '-S', '-m', 'dexgpt', *arguments, '--help'],
+                    cwd=ROOT, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=10,
+                )
+                self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
+                self.assertIn('usage:', result.stdout)
+
+    def test_pipeline_flags_are_forwarded(self):
+        workflow = Mock()
+        with patch.object(cli, 'import_module', return_value=workflow):
+            cli.main(['run-pipeline', '--inspect', '--reuse-retarget'])
+        workflow.main.assert_called_once_with(['--inspect', '--reuse-retarget'])
+
+    def test_feedback_and_explicit_image_path_are_forwarded(self):
+        workflow = Mock()
+        with patch.object(cli, 'import_module', return_value=workflow):
+            cli.main(['simulate', '--feedback'])
+            workflow.main.assert_called_once_with(feedback=True)
+            workflow.reset_mock()
+            cli.main(['inspect-artifacts', 'a directory/image.jpg'])
+            workflow.main.assert_called_once_with(['a directory/image.jpg'])
+
+    def test_invalid_flags_do_not_start_workflows(self):
+        with patch.object(cli, 'import_module') as load, contextlib.redirect_stderr(io.StringIO()):
+            with self.assertRaises(SystemExit) as caught:
+                cli.main(['project-grasp', '--inspect'])
+        self.assertEqual(caught.exception.code, 2)
+        load.assert_not_called()
+
+    def test_viewer_keeps_native_display_backend(self):
+        with patch.dict(os.environ, {}, clear=True), patch.object(cli, 'import_module'):
+            cli.main(['view-simulation'])
+            self.assertNotIn('MUJOCO_GL', os.environ)
+
+    def test_imports_and_paths_from_another_directory(self):
+        # Import every workflow with unrelated argv and no data in cwd. In
+        # particular, diagnostics must not load a scene or parse arguments here.
+        script = '''
+import importlib
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from dexgpt.cli import COMMANDS
+from dexgpt.paths import ROOT, OUT
+sys.argv = ['consumer', '--unrelated-argument']
+for module_name, _ in COMMANDS.values():
+    module = importlib.import_module(module_name)
+    assert callable(module.main), module_name
+    if hasattr(module, 'ROOT'):
+        assert module.ROOT == ROOT, module_name
+    if hasattr(module, 'OUT'):
+        assert module.OUT == OUT, module_name
+assert (OUT / 'scene.xml').is_file()
+assert not list(Path.cwd().iterdir())
+'''
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
+            result = subprocess.run(
+                [sys.executable, '-c', script], cwd=directory,
+                env={**os.environ, 'PYTHONPATH': str(ROOT)},
+                text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=120,
+            )
+        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
+        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, '')
+
+
+class WorkflowTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        self.temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
+        self.addCleanup(self.temporary.cleanup)
+        self.root = Path(self.temporary.name)
+        self.out = self.root / 'outputs'
+        self.out.mkdir()
+        # Scene mesh paths are relative to outputs, as in a real checkout.
+        (self.root / 'third_party').symlink_to(ROOT / 'third_party', target_is_directory=True)
+
+    def test_scene_build_and_simulation_initialization(self):
+        import mujoco
+        import numpy as np
+        from dexgpt.simulation import scene, rollout
+
+        with patch.object(scene, 'ROOT', self.root), contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
+            scene.main()
+        model = mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path(str(self.out / 'scene.xml'))
+        self.assertEqual(model.nu, 44)
+        state = mujoco.MjData(model)
+        with np.load(OUT / 'retargeted.npz') as track:
+            rollout.initialize(model, state, track)
+            np.testing.assert_allclose(state.ctrl, track['ctrl'][0])
+            for side_index, side in enumerate(['right', 'left']):
+                address = model.joint(side + '_root').qposadr[0]
+                np.testing.assert_allclose(state.qpos[address:address + 7], track['roots'][0, side_index])
+            self.assertAlmostEqual(state.joint('mixer_hinge').qpos[0], track['hinge_reference'][0])
+        for _ in range(10):
+            mujoco.mj_step(model, state)
+        self.assertTrue(np.isfinite(state.qpos).all())
+
+    def test_audit_and_report_generation_preserve_readme(self):
+        from dexgpt.reporting import audit, finalize
+
+        for name in ['scene.xml', 'physics_rollout.npz', 'retargeted.npz',
+                     'physics_report.json', 'tracking_report.json']:
+            shutil.copy2(OUT / name, self.out / name)
+        with patch.object(audit, 'OUT', self.out), patch.object(finalize, 'OUT', self.out), \
+                patch.object(finalize, 'ROOT', self.root), contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
+            finalize.main()
+        actual = json.loads((self.out / 'audit.json').read_text())
+        expected = json.loads((OUT / 'audit.json').read_text())
+        self.assertEqual(actual, expected)
+        self.assertEqual((self.root / 'README.md').read_text(), (ROOT / 'README.md').read_text())
+        self.assertIn('src="comparison.mp4"', (self.out / 'index.html').read_text())
+
+    def test_artifact_default_path_from_another_directory(self):
+        import base64
+        from PIL import Image
+        from dexgpt.reporting import artifacts
+
+        output = io.StringIO()
+        with contextlib.chdir(self.root), contextlib.redirect_stdout(output):
+            artifacts.main([])
+        with Image.open(io.BytesIO(base64.b64decode(output.getvalue()))) as image:
+            self.assertEqual(image.format, 'JPEG')
+            self.assertLessEqual(image.width, 1440)
+            self.assertLessEqual(image.height, 800)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    unittest.main()
